items.title: Collect PD-1 decision inputs from existing audit evidence
items.context: Read B-0f04 cross-end audit and relevant truth-source docs. Extract only the facts needed for the role decision: current CLI authority posture, Python production enforce requirements, Mac runner responsibilities, and unresolved FU-1/FU-2/FU-3 dependencies.
items.userSees: The evidence artifact contains a section titled "PD-1 Decision Inputs" with source-backed bullets for CLI posture, Python authority requirements, Mac runner responsibilities, and FU-1/FU-3 dependency.

happy.desc: Decision input section cites B-0f04 audit and Codex verification facts for CLI posture, Python enforce requirements, Mac runner responsibilities, and FU-1/FU-3 dependency.

edge.desc: Artifact defines PD-1, FU-1/FU-3, L2+, trustLevel, thin client, and enforce-mode client enough for a new agent to read without chat context.

adversarial.desc: Input section does not claim handshake/signing/receipt verification exists unless supported by B-0f04 source evidence.

verificationEvidence.note: Verified the CHK-001 evidence captures PD-1 inputs from prior audit artifacts and existing requirements docs without introducing new implementation claims.
Verified PD-1/FU-1/FU-2/FU-3, L2+, thin local/shadow client, and first-class enforce-mode authority client are defined inline for later decision review.
Verified commit 60017e1d only added the CHK-001 story evidence file; the durable authority-client-role decision doc is still absent and reserved for CHK-002.

items.title: Write the PD-1 authority client role decision artifact
items.context: Create a decision artifact under the B story evidence directory that compares thin local/shadow CLI vs first-class enforce-mode CLI. It must state the chosen/recommended option, consequences for trustLevel/L2+, and what the CLI may or may not claim before later milestones.
items.userSees: docs/requirements/decisions/authority-client-role.md displays "PD-1 Decision", "Current Decision", and "L2+ Evidence Boundary" sections with the chosen CLI role.

happy.desc: Truth-source doc explicitly chooses or recommends one PD-1 role and states whether Koala CLI can submit/certify L2+ authority evidence.

edge.desc: Story evidence links to the durable truth-source doc and the truth-source doc links back to B-4bd4/B-0f04 evidence for derivation.

adversarial.desc: Decision doc states which guarantees are not implemented yet and cannot be assumed until Milestone 2-6 stories land.

verificationEvidence.note: Verified the durable decision doc has an explicit PD-1 answer: Koala CLI remains thin local/shadow and must not claim or certify L2+ authority evidence.
Verified the story evidence links to docs/requirements/decisions/authority-client-role.md as the canonical truth source and keeps the story evidence as derivation only.

verificationEvidence.command: git show --stat --oneline --name-only 9f797fca && git diff --check HEAD~1 HEAD
verificationEvidence.note: Verified CHK-002 changed only the durable decision doc plus B-4bd4 evidence, and the doc states enforce-mode client capabilities are deferred to future dedicated stories.

items.title: Convert the decision into follow-up milestone routing
items.context: Map the decision to the next stories: Python policy discovery, CLI handshake, envelope fields, actor/signature/runner identity, and receipt verification. Mark which are required, deferred, or documentation-only depending on the decision.
items.userSees: The decision artifact contains a "Milestone Routing" table with rows for Milestone 2 through Milestone 6, each naming repo, status, prerequisite, and validation.

happy.desc: Routing table covers Milestones 2 through 6 with owning repo, required/deferred/docs-only status, prerequisite, and validation expectation.

edge.desc: Routing table clearly marks work that must not begin until user approves the PD-1 recommendation.

adversarial.desc: Routing compares next milestones against B-4622/B-da5b/B-0f04 and does not re-propose unrelated parked backlog as authority work.
